title: Binance Options Greeks & Candlesticks Input Schema

currencies.title: Crypto Currencies
currencies.description: List of cryptocurrencies to fetch from Binance Options (e.g., BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, DOGE, XRP).

candlestickInterval.title: Candlestick Interval (Klines OHLCV)
candlestickInterval.description: Candlestick bar interval from Binance spot/futures market.

candlestickLimit.title: Candlestick History (Bars Count)
candlestickLimit.description: Number of candlestick bars to fetch from Binance.

maxExpirationsPerCurrency.title: Max Expirations Per Currency
maxExpirationsPerCurrency.description: Maximum number of upcoming option expiration cycles to process per currency.

includeCandlesticks.title: Include Candlestick Table
includeCandlesticks.description: Whether to fetch and output the OHLCV candlestick price action dataset.

includeOiVolumeTable.title: Include OI & Volume Table
includeOiVolumeTable.description: Whether to output the strike-level Open Interest and Volume table.

includeFullGreeksTable.title: Include Full Greeks Table
includeFullGreeksTable.description: Whether to output the full primary and higher-order Greeks dataset.
